content.title: A Modified Glicko Model for Rating Soccer Clubs and National Teams Worldwide
content.abstract: Comparing soccer teams that rarely or never meet is a fundamental challenge in sports analytics: clubs play mostly within their national leagues, and national teams within their confederations. We propose a rating framework that places clubs and national teams worldwide on a common probabilistic scale.
